user_story:
As a user, I want to view and sort the product catalogue on the inventory page so that I can easily find the products I want to purchase. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. The user can see a list of products with their names and 'Add to cart' buttons. 
2. The user can select a sorting option from the dropdown with [data-test="product-sort-container"]. 
3. The products are sorted correctly according to the selected option. 
4. The user can add a product to the cart using the button with id [id="add-to-cart-sauce-labs-backpack"].
